LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS (LISTENING AND SPEAKING) 15.1.1 SIGNED ORAL REPORTS: EVENTS WITHIN THE CLASSROOM

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.1: Observing and Articulating Signs (Listening and Speaking) 15.1.1 Signed Oral Reports: Events within the Classroom
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating Signs (Listening and Speaking) 15.1.1 Signed Oral Reports: Events within the Classroom, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should you report activities that happen in the classroom? 2. How can you make a signed report presentation interesting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating Signs (Listening and Speaking) 15.1.1 Signed Oral Reports: Events within the Classroom together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: Learner develops the skill of creating with technology as they practise their digital knowledge by searching online for

report preparation and presentation skills.

● Critical thinking and problem solving is enhanced as learners make objective observation when evaluating the strengths and

weaknesses of their peers’ signed and oral reports.

Values:
● Peace: is enhanced as learner develops respect for self and others as they work in groups.

Link to other Subjects

The learner relates the skill of oral or signed report preparation and presentation to report presentation in Kiswahili and Religious

Education.
